description: This is team sharkx from Pakistan lahore
summary: We developed a Space Mission Planner game which helps aspiring space enthusiasts to understand the process of mission planning. It allows up to 4 people to collaborate together and performs tasks of building the rocket, budgeting, and food prep. The Unique point of the project is that multiple people can collaborate together to learn and grow as a team.
details:
The project helps in bridging the gap between children with interest of space and the actual ground reality. This is a React framework based project that uses Nodejs and Nextjs along with three.js for animating the actual rocket path. There are 3 levels : Moon, Mars, and Neptune. Each with a budget and a requirement of scientific equipment. The unique feature of this project is Multi-Platform Collaboration, where up to 4 people can join from their desktop or mobile and work on their assigned roles and launch the rocket.
The team considered Food, Budget, and Rocket Buildup as a part of the mission plan. Finally, the user selects the trajectory and launches the Rocket.
